tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Warm parchment. ink 8.1:1, muted 5.0:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised cards: status pill, stat, skill group, case card, ghost button, carousel buttons, photo frame border (6px).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Tag fill inside a stack (services, skills). Text on it is muted (4.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline and border: header bottom, cards, pills, ghost buttons, language switch, burger, case grid dividers (1px gap on a line fill).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, burger bars, ghost-button label. 8.1:1 on bg, 8.7:1 on surface, 7.5:1 on surface-2, 5.1:1 on accent.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: lede, about paragraphs, nav links, stat captions, chips, tags, section labels, footer. 5.0:1 on bg, 5.3:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on surface-2, 4.8:1 on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm soft gold, the brand colour and the lead: solid button and active language-switch fill, the brand's trailing dot, accent words in headlines, small uppercase kickers, text selection. As text it is decorative only — 1.6:1 on bg and 1.7:1 on surface (fails WCAG even at display size); kept exactly as the source has it. For legible accent text use brown (5.5:1) or put ink on an accent fill (5.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Solid button hover fill; text of the target result badge on accent-soft (2.05:1 — fails 4.5:1, kept exactly as the source has it).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Target result badge fill, contact-card corner glow, oversized case index numerals (decorative). All glows and washes are gold.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Deep brown from the portrait's gamut; used only inside the aurora wash. The one accessible warm text colour in the palette (5.5:1 on bg, 5.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill: solid button, active language-switch segment. 1.8:1 on accent — fails; kept exactly as the source has it. ink on accent reads 5.1:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Second accent from the turquoise pendant in the portrait — the cool echo of the gold. Small graphic marks only: the pulsing status dot, the section-label rule, the middle dots in the chip list, the nav hover underline, a mark on the cover. 2.5:1 on bg, so never for running text. Never on the primary button, headline accent phrases, the brand dot or the aurora.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Teal for text and lines: keyboard focus outline, nav-link, ghost-button and carousel-arrow hover, the current number in the carousel counter, text of the shipped result badge. 5.2:1 on bg, 5.6:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on teal-soft.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the shipped (actual) result badge (teal-deep text, 4.9:1); mobile-menu link hover. Never a glow: every glow is gold.

tokens.name: aurora-gold
tokens.usage: Second, paler gold of the aurora wash (used at 48% opacity there).

tokens.name: header-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky header background over a 10px backdrop blur; bg at 82%.

tokens.name: menu-glass
tokens.usage: Mobile dropdown menu background over a 12px backdrop blur; bg at 97%.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk. Headlines are fluid: each style lists its clamp(); the token holds the desktop maximum.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Hero h1, clamp(40px, 6.4vw, 76px), max-width 15ch, sentence case, one phrase in accent.

styles.name: contact-title
styles.sample: Tell me about the task — I'll tell you how to solve it.
styles.usage: Contact card h2, clamp(30px, 5vw, 58px), max-width 18ch, centred.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Not just a coder — architect + developer + initiator.
styles.usage: About h2, clamp(27px, 3.8vw, 44px); the emphasised clause in accent (em, not italic).

styles.name: case-title
styles.usage: Case card h3, clamp(22px, 3.2vw, 34px).

styles.name: case-index
styles.usage: Case number top-right of a case card, clamp(46px, 7vw, 84px), in accent-soft. Decorative.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Stat (quick-glance) value, clamp(18px, 2.1vw, 23px); separators · in accent (gold).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The name in the header, nowrap, followed by a dot in accent.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: Carousel counter, 01 / 08, muted with the current number in teal-deep, min-width 5ch.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Dot-separated chip list under the About text, muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section label: UPPERCASE, muted, preceded by a 30px teal rule.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: UPPERCASE accent kicker: case kick, case grid h4, skill group h3. Accent text is decorative-contrast; keep it short.

styles.name: pill
styles.sample: AI Automation Engineer · open to roles & freelance
styles.usage: Status pill text, muted.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags inside a stack (services, skills), muted on surface-2. Also footer and language switch (600).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Result badge, UPPERCASE.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Business-process automation, AI-assisted workflows and LLM tools — engineered for the task.
styles.usage: Hero lede, clamp(16px, 1.9vw, 19px), muted, max-width 50ch.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Now I build AI solutions: business-process automation, AI-assisted workflows, LLM tools for specific tasks.
styles.usage: About paragraphs, muted; 16px between paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Inbound leads are handled by hand — slow and lossy.
styles.usage: Case grid paragraphs, ink.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header nav links, muted → teal-deep on hover with a 2px teal underline (15px in the mobile menu, ink, teal-soft on hover).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat caption, muted, 10px under the value.

spacing.note: The site sizes most padding with clamp(); each token holds the maximum and its usage gives the full clamp.

tokens.name: space-chip
tokens.usage: Row gap of the chip list.

tokens.name: space-tag
tokens.usage: Gap between tags in a stack; gap inside a status pill is 9px.

tokens.name: space-button-icon
tokens.usage: Gap between a button's icon and label.

tokens.name: space-cta
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a CTA row and the contact links.

tokens.name: space-glance
tokens.usage: Gap between stat cards.

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Gap between skill groups; gap in the header bar; between About paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-controls
tokens.usage: Gap between carousel controls and above them; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-heading
tokens.usage: Lede below the hero title; chips below the About text.

tokens.name: space-nav
tokens.usage: Gap between header nav links.

tokens.name: space-label

tokens.name: space-cta-top
tokens.usage: CTA row below the lede; contact links below the contact title.

tokens.name: gutter

tokens.name: pad-card

tokens.name: pad-case

tokens.name: pad-contact
